rules.rule_name: Initialize a Blank Transaction Record Before Population
rules.rule_description: Before populating any fields, a new transaction record must be initialized to a clean/blank state to ensure no residual or stale data from previous operations contaminates the new transaction entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize a blank Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has passed all input validations for Account/Card Number and all transaction data fields, and has confirmed the intent to add a new transaction by entering 'Y' in the Confirm field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins the process of creating a new transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must initialize the transaction record to a completely blank/empty state, clearing all fields, before any new data is written into it

rules.rule_name: Auto-Generate and Assign a Unique Transaction ID to the New Record
rules.rule_description: The system automatically determines the next available Transaction ID by reading the last (highest) existing Transaction ID from the transaction file and incrementing it by 1. This generated ID is then assigned to the new transaction record. The user does not manually enter a Transaction ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assign newly generated Transaction ID to record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been initialized to a blank state and the system has retrieved the most recently added transaction's ID from the transaction file by browsing to the end of the file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system generates the new Transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must take the last existing Transaction ID, add 1 to it to produce the next sequential Transaction ID, and assign this newly generated Transaction ID to the new transaction record

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Type Code from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Type Code entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty and numeric prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Type Code from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new transaction record has been initialized and assigned a Transaction ID, and the user has provided a valid numeric Transaction Type Code on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Transaction Type Code value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Type Code field

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Category Code from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Category Code entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty and numeric prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Category Code from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated with Transaction ID and Type Code, and the user has provided a valid numeric Transaction Category Code on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Transaction Category Code value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Category Code field

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Source from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Source entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Source from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated with Transaction ID, Type Code, and Category Code, and the user has provided a valid Transaction Source on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Transaction Source value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Source field

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Description from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Description entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Transaction Description from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated with Transaction ID, Type Code, Category Code, and Source, and the user has provided a valid Transaction Description on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Transaction Description value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Description field

rules.rule_name: Convert Transaction Amount to Numeric Value and Assign to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Amount entered by the user in the format ±99999999.99 must be converted from its display/character representation into a true numeric value before being stored on the transaction record. This ensures the amount is stored in a computationally usable numeric format.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Convert Transaction Amount to numeric value and set on record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated and the user has provided a valid Transaction Amount in the format ±99999999.99 (e.g., -00012345.67 or +00012345.67) which has already passed format and content validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the Transaction Amount for storage
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must convert the character-formatted amount string into a numeric value using a numeric conversion function (NUMVAL-C), and then assign the resulting numeric amount to the transaction record's Amount field

rules.rule_name: Assign Card Number from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Card Number associated with the transaction is recorded onto the new transaction record. This is the card number that was either entered directly by the user or auto-populated via Account ID cross-reference lookup, and has already been validated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Card Number from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated and a valid Card Number is present on the screen — either entered directly by the user or auto-populated from the Account ID cross-reference lookup
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Card Number value from the screen onto the transaction record's Card Number field

rules.rule_name: Assign Merchant ID from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Merchant ID entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty and numeric prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Merchant ID from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated with Transaction ID, Type Code, Category Code, Source, Description, Amount, and Card Number, and the user has provided a valid numeric Merchant ID on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Merchant ID value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Merchant ID field

rules.rule_name: Assign Merchant Name from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Merchant Name entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Merchant Name from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated including Merchant ID, and the user has provided a valid Merchant Name on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Merchant Name value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Merchant Name field

rules.rule_name: Assign Merchant City from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Merchant City entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Merchant City from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated including Merchant ID and Merchant Name, and the user has provided a valid Merchant City on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Merchant City value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Merchant City field

rules.rule_name: Assign Merchant Zip Code from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Merchant Zip Code entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Merchant Zip from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated including Merchant ID, Merchant Name, and Merchant City, and the user has provided a valid Merchant Zip Code on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Merchant Zip Code value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Merchant Zip field

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Origination Date from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Origination Date entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty, correctly formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, and confirmed as a real calendar date prior to this step.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Origination Date from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been partially populated with all merchant details, and the user has provided a valid Origination Date in YYYY-MM-DD format that has passed both format and calendar validity checks
acceptance_criteria.When: The system continues populating the transaction record fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Origination Date value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Origination Date/Timestamp field

rules.rule_name: Assign Transaction Processing Date from User Input to Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Processing Date entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen is recorded onto the new transaction record. This field has already been validated as non-empty, correctly formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, and confirmed as a real calendar date prior to this step. This is the final field populated before the record is written to the transaction file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Processing Date from user input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The transaction record has been populated with all required fields including Origination Date, and the user has provided a valid Processing Date in YYYY-MM-DD format that has passed both format and calendar validity checks
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the final field on the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must copy the Processing Date value entered by the user directly onto the transaction record's Processing Date/Timestamp field, completing the population of all transaction record fields and making the record ready to be written to the transaction file

key_functionalities.title: Transaction Record Write
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Write New Transaction Record])
    WRITE[Attempt to Write\nNew Transaction Record\nto Transaction File]
    TRANSACT_W[(TRANSACT\nTransaction File)]
    OUTCOME{Write\nOutcome?}

    SUCCESS[Clear All Input Fields\nReset Form to Blank]
    SUCCESS_MSG[_Build Success Message:\n'Transaction added successfully.\nYour Tran ID is XXXXXXXXXX'_]
    SUCCESS_DISPLAY[Display Success Message\nin Green on Screen]

    DUP_ERR[Display Error Message:\n'Tran ID already exists...']

    FAIL_ERR[Display Error Message:\n'Unable to Add Transaction...']

    DISPLAY_SCREEN([Refresh and Display\nAdd Transaction Screen])

    START --> WRITE
    WRITE --> TRANSACT_W
    TRANSACT_W -.->|Write Result| OUTCOME

    OUTCOME -->|Successful Write| SUCCESS
    SUCCESS --> SUCCESS_MSG
    SUCCESS_MSG --> SUCCESS_DISPLAY
    SUCCESS_DISPLAY --> DISPLAY_SCREEN

    OUTCOME -->|Duplicate Transaction ID| DUP_ERR
    DUP_ERR --> DISPLAY_SCREEN

    OUTCOME -->|Write Failure| FAIL_ERR
    FAIL_ERR --> DISPLAY_SCREEN

rules.rule_name: Write New Transaction Record to Transaction File
rules.rule_description: When all validations pass and the user confirms, the system attempts to persist the new transaction record with all its details into the Transaction File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Attempt to Write New Transaction Record to Transaction File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A new transaction record has been fully populated with: auto-generated Transaction ID, Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Description, Amount, Card Number, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip, Original Date, and Processing Date
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to write the new transaction record to the Transaction File using the auto-generated Transaction ID as the record key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction File receives the new record and returns a write outcome (Successful Write, Duplicate Transaction ID, or Write Failure)

rules.rule_name: Successful Transaction Write - Clear Form and Build Success Message
rules.rule_description: Upon a successful write of the new transaction record, the system clears all input fields on the Add Transaction screen, resetting the form to a blank state ready for a new entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Input Fields / Reset Form to Blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully written the new transaction record to the Transaction File
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation returns a successful outcome
acceptance_criteria.Then: All input fields on the Add Transaction screen are cleared to spaces, including: Account ID, Card Number, Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount, Description, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip, and Confirm field; and the cursor is repositioned to the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Successful Transaction Write - Construct Success Message with Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: After a successful transaction write and form reset, the system constructs a confirmation message that includes the newly assigned Transaction ID so the user can reference the transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Build Success Message: 'Transaction added successfully. Your Tran ID is XXXXXXXXXX'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The new transaction record has been successfully written to the Transaction File and all input fields have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The system builds the success confirmation message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system constructs the message by concatenating: the text 'Transaction added successfully. ', followed by ' Your Tran ID is ', followed by the newly assigned Transaction ID value (trimmed of trailing spaces), followed by a period '.'; the complete message is stored in the screen message field

rules.rule_name: Successful Transaction Write - Display Success Message in Green
rules.rule_description: The success confirmation message is displayed to the user in green color on the Add Transaction screen to visually distinguish it from error messages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Success Message in Green on Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The success message containing the new Transaction ID has been constructed
acceptance_criteria.When: The Add Transaction screen is refreshed and displayed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The success message is displayed in green color in the message area of the Add Transaction screen, confirming the transaction was added and showing the assigned Transaction ID

rules.rule_name: Duplicate Transaction ID - Reject Write and Display Error
rules.rule_description: If the auto-generated Transaction ID already exists in the Transaction File (duplicate key condition), the system rejects the write and informs the user that the Transaction ID is already in use.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: 'Tran ID already exists...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write a new transaction record to the Transaction File
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation returns a Duplicate Transaction ID outcome (either duplicate key or duplicate record condition)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error flag is set to indicate an error condition; the error message 'Tran ID already exist...' is displayed in the message area of the Add Transaction screen; the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field; the Add Transaction screen is refreshed and redisplayed with the error

rules.rule_name: Transaction Write Failure - Display System Error
rules.rule_description: If the transaction write fails for any reason other than a duplicate Transaction ID, the system informs the user that the transaction could not be added.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: 'Unable to Add Transaction...'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write a new transaction record to the Transaction File
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation returns a failure outcome that is neither a successful write nor a duplicate Transaction ID condition
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error flag is set to indicate an error condition; the error message 'Unable to Add Transaction...' is displayed in the message area of the Add Transaction screen; the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field; the Add Transaction screen is refreshed and redisplayed with the error

rules.rule_name: Refresh and Display Add Transaction Screen After Write Outcome
rules.rule_description: Regardless of the write outcome (success, duplicate, or failure), the Add Transaction screen is always refreshed and redisplayed to the user with the appropriate message.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Refresh and Display Add Transaction Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The write operation to the Transaction File has completed with any outcome (success, duplicate Transaction ID, or write failure)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to return control to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with current date and time, program name, and transaction name; displays the appropriate message (success in green or error) in the message area; and sends the refreshed Add Transaction screen (map COTRN2A from mapset COTRN02) to the user's terminal, returning control with the current transaction ID and communication area preserved

rules.rule_name: Clear Account ID and Card Number After Successful Transaction Add
rules.rule_description: After a transaction is successfully written to the system, the Account ID and Card Number input fields must be cleared to blank so the form is ready for a new transaction entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear All Input Fields
Account ID, Card Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved to the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the post-success field initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID field (ACTIDINI) and Card Number field (CARDNINI) on the Add Transaction screen are both cleared to spaces, and the cursor is repositioned to the Account ID field

rules.rule_name: Clear Transaction Detail Fields After Successful Transaction Add
rules.rule_description: After a transaction is successfully saved, all transaction detail fields — Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount, and Description — must be cleared to blank to prepare the screen for a new transaction entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Transaction Detail Fields
Type Code, Category Code,
Source, Amount, Description

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved to the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the post-success field initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field (TTYPCDI), Category Code field (TCATCDI), Source field (TRNSRCI), Amount field (TRNAMTI), and Description field (TDESCI) on the Add Transaction screen are all cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: Clear Date Fields After Successful Transaction Add
rules.rule_description: After a transaction is successfully saved, the Origination Date and Processing Date fields must be cleared to blank so the form is ready for a new transaction entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Date Fields
Origination Date, Processing Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved to the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the post-success field initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Origination Date field (TORIGDTI) and Processing Date field (TPROCDTI) on the Add Transaction screen are both cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: Clear Merchant Fields After Successful Transaction Add
rules.rule_description: After a transaction is successfully saved, all merchant-related fields — Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant Zip — must be cleared to blank to prepare the screen for a new transaction entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Merchant Fields
Merchant ID, Name, City, Zip

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved to the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the post-success field initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Merchant ID field (MIDI), Merchant Name field (MNAMEI), Merchant City field (MCITYI), and Merchant Zip field (MZIPI) on the Add Transaction screen are all cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: Clear Confirmation Field and Message Area After Successful Transaction Add
rules.rule_description: After a transaction is successfully saved, the Confirmation field and the message area must be cleared to blank so the screen is clean and ready for a new transaction entry before the success message is composed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear Confirmation Field
and Message Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved to the transaction file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs the post-success field initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) and the working storage message area (WS-MESSAGE) are both cleared to spaces

rules.rule_name: Compose Success Message with Newly Assigned Transaction ID
rules.rule_description: After all fields are cleared following a successful transaction save, the system must compose and display a success message that includes the newly assigned Transaction ID, so the user has a reference for the transaction just created. The message is displayed in green color to indicate success.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Compose Success Message
with New Transaction ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction has been successfully added and saved, and all input fields have been cleared
acceptance_criteria.When: The system composes the post-success confirmation message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message area (WS-MESSAGE) is populated with the text 'Transaction added successfully. Your Tran ID is [TRAN-ID].' where [TRAN-ID] is the auto-generated Transaction ID assigned to the newly created transaction, and the message color attribute (ERRMSGC) is set to green to visually indicate success

rules.rule_name: Display Refreshed Add Transaction Screen Ready for New Entry
rules.rule_description: After composing the success message, the system must redisplay the Add Transaction screen in a fully cleared state with the success message visible, the current date and time in the header, and the cursor positioned at the Account ID field, so the user can immediately begin entering a new transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Refreshed
Add Transaction Screen
Ready for New Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: All input fields have been cleared and the success message with the new Transaction ID has been composed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the refreshed Add Transaction screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Add Transaction screen (COTRN2A in mapset COTRN02) is displayed with: all input fields blank, the success message 'Transaction added successfully. Your Tran ID is [TRAN-ID].' shown in green in the message area, the screen header populated with current date and time, program name, and transaction name, and the cursor positioned at the Account ID field ready for new input

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: Before populating the screen header, the system retrieves the current system date and time so that accurate date and time values can be displayed to the user on the Add Transaction screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen is about to be displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header population process is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time and stores it in the working date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA), making the current month, day, year, hours, minutes, and seconds available for subsequent header field population

rules.rule_name: Populate Application Title Line 1 on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The first line of the application title, sourced from the application's central title definition (CCDA-TITLE01), is placed into the screen header area so that users can identify the application they are working within.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Application Title Line 1
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress and the current system date and time have been retrieved
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the first title line of the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The application's first title line (CCDA-TITLE01) is copied into the Title Line 1 output field (TITLE01O) of the Add Transaction screen header

rules.rule_name: Populate Application Title Line 2 on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The second line of the application title, sourced from the application's central title definition (CCDA-TITLE02), is placed into the screen header area to complete the application identification displayed to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Application Title Line 2
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress and Title Line 1 has been populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the second title line of the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The application's second title line (CCDA-TITLE02) is copied into the Title Line 2 output field (TITLE02O) of the Add Transaction screen header

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction ID on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current transaction identifier (the CICS transaction ID under which the program is running) is displayed in the screen header so that users and support staff can identify the active transaction context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Transaction ID
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress and both application title lines have been populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction identifier field of the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) is copied into the Transaction Name output field (TRNNAMEO) of the Add Transaction screen header

rules.rule_name: Populate Program Name on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The name of the currently executing program is displayed in the screen header so that users and support staff can identify which program is being executed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Program Name
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress and the transaction ID has been populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the program name field of the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current program name (WS-PGMNAME) is copied into the Program Name output field (PGMNAMEO) of the Add Transaction screen header

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Date as MM-DD-YY on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current system date is formatted into the MM-DD-YY display format for presentation in the screen header. The year is represented as a 2-digit value extracted from the last two digits of the 4-digit year.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Current Date
as MM-DD-YY
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress, the program name has been populated, and the current system date has been retrieved into WS-CURDATE-DATA containing separate month (WS-CURDATE-MONTH), day (WS-CURDATE-DAY), and 4-digit year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR) components
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the current date for display in the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current month is moved to WS-CURDATE-MM, the current day is moved to WS-CURDATE-DD, and only the last two digits of the current year (positions 3-4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) are moved to WS-CURDATE-YY; the resulting MM-DD-YY formatted date (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) is then placed into the Current Date output field (CURDATEO) of the Add Transaction screen header

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Time as HH-MM-SS on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The current system time is formatted into the HH-MM-SS display format for presentation in the screen header, using hours, minutes, and seconds components extracted from the retrieved system time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Current Time
as HH-MM-SS
onto Screen Header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen header population process is in progress, the formatted date has been populated, and the current system time has been retrieved into WS-CURDATE-DATA containing separate hours (WS-CURTIME-HOURS), minutes (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE), and seconds (WS-CURTIME-SECOND) components
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the current time for display in the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current hours are moved to WS-CURTIME-HH, the current minutes are moved to WS-CURTIME-MM, and the current seconds are moved to WS-CURTIME-SS; the resulting HH-MM-SS formatted time (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is then placed into the Current Time output field (CURTIMEO) of the Add Transaction screen header

key_functionalities.title: Add Transaction Screen Display
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([34: Add Transaction Screen Display])
    P1[Retrieve Current System Date and Time]
    P2[Populate Screen Header\nApplication Title Line 1 and Line 2]
    P3[Populate Screen Header\nTransaction ID and Program Name]
    P4[Populate Screen Header\nCurrent Date in MM-DD-YY format]
    P5[Populate Screen Header\nCurrent Time in HH-MM-SS format]
    P6[Move Validation or Status Message\nto Screen Message Field]
    P7[Send Add Transaction Screen\nto User Terminal]
    P8[Await Next User Interaction\nReturn control with Transaction ID\nand Communication Area]

    START --> P1
    P1 --> P2

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time for Screen Header
rules.rule_description: When preparing the Add Transaction screen for display, the system must retrieve the current system date and time to populate the screen header with accurate timestamp information.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Current System Date and Time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen is being prepared for display to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates the screen population process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the current system date and time using the CURRENT-DATE function and stores it in the working storage date-time field (WS-CURDATE-DATA), making both date components (year, month, day) and time components (hours, minutes, seconds) available for subsequent header population

rules.rule_name: Populate Application Title Lines in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Add Transaction screen header must display the standard application title on two lines, sourced from the centrally defined application constants, to provide consistent branding and context to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen Header
Application Title Line 1 and Line 2

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen header is being populated and the application title constants (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02) are defined in the common application data area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies Application Title Line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01) into the screen output field TITLE01O and Application Title Line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02) into the screen output field TITLE02O of the Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO)

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction ID and Program Name in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Add Transaction screen header must display the current transaction identifier and the program name to allow users and support staff to identify the active transaction and program context.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen Header
Transaction ID and Program Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen header is being populated and the current Transaction ID (WS-TRANID) and Program Name (WS-PGMNAME) are available in working storage
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the screen header fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the Transaction ID (WS-TRANID) into the screen output field TRNNAMEO and the Program Name (WS-PGMNAME) into the screen output field PGMNAMEO of the Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO)

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Date in MM-DD-YY Format on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Add Transaction screen header must display the current date formatted as MM-DD-YY (2-digit month, 2-digit day, 2-digit year) to provide the user with a recognizable and standardized date reference.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen Header
Current Date in MM-DD-YY format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA, with individual components available as WS-CURDATE-MONTH (month), WS-CURDATE-DAY (day), and WS-CURDATE-YEAR (4-digit year)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the current date for the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the 2-digit month into WS-CURDATE-MM, the 2-digit day into WS-CURDATE-DD, and the last 2 digits of the year (positions 3-4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) into WS-CURDATE-YY, then assembles these into the MM-DD-YY formatted field WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY and copies it into the screen output field CURDATEO of the Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO)

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Time in HH-MM-SS Format on Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Add Transaction screen header must display the current time formatted as HH-MM-SS (2-digit hours, 2-digit minutes, 2-digit seconds) to provide the user with an accurate time reference on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Populate Screen Header
Current Time in HH-MM-SS format

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA, with individual components available as WS-CURTIME-HOURS (hours), WS-CURTIME-MINUTE (minutes), and WS-CURTIME-SECOND (seconds)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats the current time for the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system extracts the 2-digit hours into WS-CURTIME-HH, the 2-digit minutes into WS-CURTIME-MM, and the 2-digit seconds into WS-CURTIME-SS, then assembles these into the HH-MM-SS formatted field WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS and copies it into the screen output field CURTIMEO of the Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO)

rules.rule_name: Display Validation or Status Message on Add Transaction Screen
rules.rule_description: Any validation error message or status message generated during input processing must be transferred to the screen message field so the user receives clear feedback about the outcome of their action or the nature of any input error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Move Validation or Status Message
to Screen Message Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: A validation error message or status message has been set in the working storage message field (WS-MESSAGE) — this may be a field-level validation error (e.g., 'Account ID must be Numeric...', 'Amount can NOT be empty...', 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD'), a lookup error (e.g., 'Account ID NOT found...', 'Card Number NOT found...'), a confirmation prompt (e.g., 'Confirm to add this transaction...'), a success message (e.g., 'Transaction added successfully. Your Tran ID is [ID].'), or an invalid key message
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the Add Transaction screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the contents of WS-MESSAGE into the screen error/message output field ERRMSGO of the Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO), making the message visible to the user on the screen

rules.rule_name: Send Add Transaction Screen to User Terminal
rules.rule_description: After all header and message fields have been populated, the fully assembled Add Transaction screen must be transmitted to the user's terminal, erasing any previous screen content and positioning the cursor at the designated input field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Send Add Transaction Screen
to User Terminal

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen map (COTRN2AO) has been fully populated with header information, field data, and any validation or status messages
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system transmits the Add Transaction screen using map name 'COTRN2A' from mapset 'COTRN02', erasing the previous terminal content (ERASE), and positioning the cursor at the field designated by the cursor control setting (CURSOR), so the user sees a fully refreshed screen with the cursor in the appropriate input position

rules.rule_name: Await Next User Interaction by Returning Control with Transaction Context
rules.rule_description: After sending the screen, the system must suspend processing and wait for the user's next input. The current transaction identifier and the full communication area (containing session state) must be preserved and passed forward so the application can resume correctly when the user responds.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Await Next User Interaction
Return control with Transaction ID
and Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen has been successfully sent to the user terminal
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the current processing cycle
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system returns control to the CICS transaction manager, specifying the current Transaction ID (WS-TRANID) as the next transaction to be invoked when the user responds, and passing the current Communication Area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) to preserve the session context — including program state, navigation history, and any pre-selected transaction data — so that when the user presses a key, the same transaction resumes with full context intact

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error flag is set to OFF, the user-modified flag is set to NO, the screen message field (WS-MESSAGE) is cleared to spaces, and the error message output field (ERRMSGO) on the Add Transaction screen is cleared to spaces

all_rules.Rule_Name: Program Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the start of each program execution, all error indicators, user-modification flags, and message fields are reset to ensure a clean processing state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No communication area exists (session length equals zero, indicating no active session)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The target program is set to 'COSGN00C' (Sign-On screen) and control is transferred to that program, preventing access to the Add Transaction function without a valid session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Session Validation and Redirect to Sign-On
all_rules.Rule_Description: If no active session context exists when the program is invoked, the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen to establish a valid session before proceeding.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid session exists and the user is entering the Add Transaction screen for the first time (program re-entry flag is not set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program detects it is the initial entry
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program marks itself as re-enterable, clears the screen output area to LOW-VALUES, positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and if a pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED) is present (not spaces and not LOW-VALUES), it is moved into the Card Number input field and the Enter Key processing logic is immediately invoked; the Add Transaction screen is then displayed to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: First-Time Screen Display and Pre-Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: On the first entry to the Add Transaction screen, the screen is initialized and, if a transaction was pre-selected from a prior screen, the Card Number field is pre-populated and processing begins automatically.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid session exists and the user has previously been presented with the Add Transaction screen (program re-entry flag is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits input from the Add Transaction screen (map COTRN2A, mapset COTRN02)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All user-entered data is received into the input map area (COTRN2AI) and made available for key-press evaluation and business logic processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Input Reception
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a returning user interacts with the Add Transaction screen, the system receives and captures all input data entered by the user for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted input from the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The key pressed is the Enter key (DFHENTER)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the input key field validation, input data field validation, and confirmation check sequence to process the transaction addition request

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enter Key Processing Routing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses the Enter key, the system routes processing to the full validation and transaction addition workflow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted input from the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF3
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a calling program is recorded in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM (not spaces and not LOW-VALUES), control is transferred to that program; otherwise, control is transferred to the default menu program 'COMEN01C'; in both cases, the current transaction ID and program name are recorded as the originating context, and the program context counter is reset to zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Navigate Back to Previous Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3, the system navigates back to the program that invoked the Add Transaction screen, or defaults to the main menu if no calling program is recorded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted input from the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF4
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All input fields are cleared to spaces (Account ID, Card Number, Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount, Description, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip, Confirm), the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, the message field is cleared, and the blank Add Transaction screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen on PF4
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF4, all input fields on the Add Transaction screen are cleared, presenting a blank form for new data entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted input from the Add Transaction screen with a valid Account ID or Card Number entered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF5
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system first validates the Account ID or Card Number; if valid, it browses the transaction file from the highest key backwards to retrieve the last transaction record, and if no error exists, it copies the following fields from the last transaction to the screen: Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount (formatted), Description, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant Zip; the Enter Key processing logic is then invoked to validate and prompt for confirmation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Copy Last Transaction Data on PF5
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF5, the system retrieves the most recently added transaction from the transaction file and pre-populates the transaction detail fields on the screen, allowing the user to reuse prior transaction details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted input from the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error flag is set to 'Y', the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) is placed in the message field, and the Add Transaction screen is redisplayed with the error message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Key Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses any key other than Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5, the system displays an invalid key error message.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the Account ID field (not spaces and not LOW-VALUES) on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field is evaluated during key field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID value is not numeric, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Account ID must be Numeric...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Account ID is numeric, it is converted to a numeric value and processing continues to the Account ID cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Numeric Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Account ID is provided, it must contain only numeric characters before a cross-reference lookup can be performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID has been validated as numeric and converted to its numeric form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup of the Account ID in the Account Cross-Reference Alternate Index file (CXACAIX)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID is found, the corresponding Card Number from the cross-reference record is moved into the Card Number input field (CARDNINI) on the screen and processing continues to data field validation; if the Account ID is not found, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Account ID NOT found...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cross-Reference Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: A valid numeric Account ID is looked up in the Account Cross-Reference file (CXACAIX) to retrieve the associated Card Number, which is then auto-populated on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID field is empty and the user has entered a value in the Card Number field (not spaces and not LOW-VALUES) on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field is evaluated during key field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Number value is not numeric, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Card Number must be Numeric...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Card Number field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Card Number is numeric, it is converted to a numeric value and processing continues to the Card Number cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Numeric Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number is provided (and no Account ID is entered), it must contain only numeric characters before a cross-reference lookup can be performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number has been validated as numeric and converted to its numeric form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup of the Card Number in the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Card Number is found, the corresponding Account ID from the cross-reference record is moved into the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI) on the screen and processing continues to data field validation; if the Card Number is not found, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Card Number NOT found...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Card Number field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Cross-Reference Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: A valid numeric Card Number is looked up in the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) to retrieve the associated Account ID, which is then auto-populated on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Both the Account ID field and the Card Number field are empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Account or Card Number must be entered...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the screen is redisplayed; transaction processing cannot proceed without at least one identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account or Card Number Presence Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: At least one of Account ID or Card Number must be provided by the user to identify the account for the transaction being added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account ID or Card Number has been successfully validated and cross-referenced
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Type Code field (TTYPCDI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Type Code is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Type CD can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Type Code field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Type Code is present but not numeric, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Type CD must be Numeric...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Type Code field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Type Code is present and numeric, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type Code Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type Code is a mandatory numeric field that must be provided and must contain only numeric characters.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Code has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Category Code field (TCATCDI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Category Code is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Category CD can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Category Code field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Category Code is present but not numeric, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Category CD must be Numeric...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Category Code field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Category Code is present and numeric, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Category Code Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Category Code is a mandatory numeric field that must be provided and must contain only numeric characters.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Category Code has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Source field (TRNSRCI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Source field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Source can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Source field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Source field contains a value, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Source Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Source is a mandatory field that must be provided before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Source has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Description field (TDESCI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Description field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Description can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Description field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Description field contains a value, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Description Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Description is a mandatory field that must be provided before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Description has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Amount field (TRNAMTI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Amount field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Amount can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Amount field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Amount is present but does not conform to the format where position 1 is '+' or '-', positions 2 through 9 (8 characters) are numeric, position 10 is '.', and positions 11 through 12 (2 characters) are numeric, then the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Amount field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Amount is valid, it is converted to a numeric value and reformatted to the standard display format before processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Amount is mandatory and must follow a strict format: a sign character followed by 8 numeric digits, a decimal point, and 2 numeric decimal digits.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Amount has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Origination Date field (TORIGDTI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Origination Date is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Orig Date can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Origination Date field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Origination Date is present but does not conform to the format where positions 1-4 are numeric (year), position 5 is '-', positions 6-7 are numeric (month), position 8 is '-', and positions 9-10 are numeric (day), then the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Origination Date field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the format is valid, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Origination Date is mandatory and must conform to the YYYY-MM-DD format with correct positional separators.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Origination Date format has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Processing Date field (TPROCDTI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Processing Date is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Proc Date can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Processing Date field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Processing Date is present but does not conform to the format where positions 1-4 are numeric (year), position 5 is '-', positions 6-7 are numeric (month), position 8 is '-', and positions 9-10 are numeric (day), then the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Proc Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Processing Date field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the format is valid, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Processing Date Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Processing Date is mandatory and must conform to the YYYY-MM-DD format with correct positional separators.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Origination Date has passed format validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date validation utility CSUTLDTC is called with the Origination Date value and the expected date format
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the utility returns a severity code of '0000' (success), the date is accepted as valid and processing continues; if the utility returns any other severity code and the message number is not '2513', the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Orig Date - Not a valid date...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Origination Date field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Calendar Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After format validation, the Origination Date must be verified as a real calendar date by invoking the date validation utility CSUTLDTC.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Processing Date has passed format validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date validation utility CSUTLDTC is called with the Processing Date value and the expected date format
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the utility returns a severity code of '0000' (success), the date is accepted as valid and processing continues; if the utility returns any other severity code and the message number is not '2513', the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Proc Date - Not a valid date...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Processing Date field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Processing Date Calendar Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After format validation, the Processing Date must be verified as a real calendar date by invoking the date validation utility CSUTLDTC.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Processing Date has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Merchant ID field (MIDI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Merchant ID is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Merchant ID can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Merchant ID field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Merchant ID is present but not numeric, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Merchant ID must be Numeric...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Merchant ID field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Merchant ID is present and numeric, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Merchant ID Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Merchant ID is a mandatory numeric field that must be provided and must contain only numeric characters.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Merchant ID has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Merchant Name field (MNAMEI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Merchant Name field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Merchant Name can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Merchant Name field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Merchant Name field contains a value, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Merchant Name Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Merchant Name is a mandatory field that must be provided before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Merchant Name has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Merchant City field (MCITYI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Merchant City field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Merchant City can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Merchant City field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Merchant City field contains a value, processing continues

all_rules.Rule_Name: Merchant City Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Merchant City is a mandatory field that must be provided before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Merchant City has been successfully validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Merchant Zip Code field (MZIPI) is evaluated during data field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Merchant Zip Code field is empty (spaces or LOW-VALUES), the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Merchant Zip can NOT be empty...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Merchant Zip field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the Merchant Zip Code field contains a value, processing continues to the confirmation check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Merchant Zip Code Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Merchant Zip Code is a mandatory field that must be provided before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All input key fields and data fields have passed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirm field (CONFIRMI) value is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Confirm field contains 'Y' or 'y', the transaction addition process is invoked; if the Confirm field contains 'N', 'n', spaces, or LOW-VALUES, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Confirm to add this transaction...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Confirm field, and the screen is redisplayed prompting the user to confirm; if the Confirm field contains any other value, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Confirm field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Add Confirmation Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before a transaction is permanently added, the user must explicitly confirm the action by entering Y. Entering N or leaving the field blank prompts the user to confirm. Any other value is treated as invalid.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has confirmed the transaction addition with 'Y'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system generates a new Transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction file is browsed starting from the highest possible key value (HIGH-VALUES) in reverse order to retrieve the last (highest) existing Transaction ID; the browse is then ended; the retrieved Transaction ID is incremented by 1 to produce the new unique Transaction ID for the transaction being added

all_rules.Rule_Name: New Transaction ID Generation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system automatically generates a unique Transaction ID by retrieving the highest existing Transaction ID from the transaction file and incrementing it by 1.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new Transaction ID has been generated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction record is being prepared for writing to the transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction record is initialized to empty values and then populated with: the auto-generated Transaction ID, Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI), Transaction Description (TDESCI), Transaction Amount converted to numeric (TRNAMTI), Card Number (CARDNINI), Merchant ID (MIDI), Merchant Name (MNAMEI), Merchant City (MCITYI), Merchant Zip (MZIPI), Original Date/Timestamp (TORIGDTI), and Processing Date/Timestamp (TPROCDTI)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Record Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: A new transaction record is assembled by populating all fields from the validated screen input and the auto-generated Transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction record has been fully populated with all validated field values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the new transaction record to the transaction file (TRANSACT)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write is successful, all input fields are cleared, a success message in green is displayed reading 'Transaction added successfully. Your Tran ID is [new Transaction ID].', and the screen is redisplayed for new entry; if the write fails due to a duplicate Transaction ID, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Tran ID already exist...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the screen is redisplayed; if the write fails for any other reason, the error flag is set to 'Y', the message 'Unable to Add Transaction...' is displayed, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field, and the screen is redisplayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Record Write and Outcome Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fully populated transaction record is written to the transaction file, and the outcome determines whether a success or error message is presented to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen is about to be sent to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header population routine is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen header is populated with: the application title line 1 (CCDA-TITLE01), the application title line 2 (CCDA-TITLE02), the current transaction ID (WS-TRANID), the current program name (WS-PGMNAME), the current date formatted as MM/DD/YY, and the current time formatted as HH:MM:SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Header Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before displaying the Add Transaction screen, the header area is populated with current system information including titles, program identity, current date, and current time.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen header has been populated and a message (error or status) has been set in WS-MESSAGE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Add Transaction screen to the user terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message from WS-MESSAGE is moved to the screen error message output field (ERRMSGO), the screen map COTRN2A from mapset COTRN02 is sent to the terminal with the ERASE option to clear the previous screen and the CURSOR option to position the cursor on the designated field; the program then returns control to CICS awaiting the next user interaction, passing the current transaction ID and communication area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Transaction Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Add Transaction screen is sent to the user terminal with all current field values, the current message (error or status), and the cursor positioned on the relevant field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is beginning data field validation after key field validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The error flag is already set to ON (indicating a prior key field validation failure)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All transaction data input fields are cleared to spaces: Transaction Type Code (TTYPCDI), Transaction Category Code (TCATCDI), Transaction Source (TRNSRCI), Transaction Amount (TRNAMTI), Transaction Description (TDESCI), Origination Date (TORIGDTI), Processing Date (TPROCDTI), Merchant ID (MIDI), Merchant Name (MNAMEI), Merchant City (MCITYI), and Merchant Zip (MZIPI)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Data Fields Cleared on Key Field Validation Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a key field validation error (Account ID or Card Number) has occurred, all transaction data fields are cleared from the screen to prevent processing of potentially mismatched data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program (COTRN2AC) has been invoked for any reason, including initial entry, re-entry after user input, or navigation from another screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution at the start of the main processing paragraph (MAIN-PARA)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error flag (ERR-FLG) must be set to OFF (ERR-FLG-OFF = TRUE), ensuring no prior error condition carries forward into the current processing cycle

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Error Flag at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the beginning of every program invocation for the Add Transaction screen, the error flag must be reset to its default OFF state to ensure no residual error state from a previous interaction affects the current processing cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program (COTRN2AC) has been invoked for any reason, including initial entry, re-entry after user input, or navigation from another screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution immediately after the error flag has been reset
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The user-modified flag (USR-MODIFIED) must be set to NO (USR-MODIFIED-NO = TRUE), indicating that no user modifications have been detected yet in the current processing cycle

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset User-Modified Flag at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the beginning of every program invocation for the Add Transaction screen, the user-modified indicator must be reset to NO to ensure the system correctly tracks whether the user has made any changes during the current interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program (COTRN2AC) has been invoked for any reason, including initial entry, re-entry after user input, or navigation from another screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution immediately after the user-modified flag has been reset
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The internal working message field (WS-MESSAGE) must be set to spaces (blank), removing any message text that may have been set during a prior program invocation or interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Working Message Field at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the beginning of every program invocation for the Add Transaction screen, the internal working message field must be cleared to spaces to ensure no residual message text from a previous interaction is inadvertently displayed or processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction program (COTRN2AC) has been invoked for any reason, including initial entry, re-entry after user input, or navigation from another screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution immediately after the working message field has been cleared
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen-displayed error message field (ERRMSGO on screen map COTRN2AO) must be set to spaces (blank), ensuring the user does not see any error message carried over from a previous screen interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen Error Message Field at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the beginning of every program invocation for the Add Transaction screen, the error message field displayed on the screen must be cleared to spaces to ensure no stale error message from a previous interaction remains visible to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user attempts to access the Add Transaction screen (program COTRN2AC)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session communication area length (EIBCALEN) equals zero, indicating no active session data or communication context is present
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the user as unauthenticated with no active session, and proceeds to redirect the user to the Sign-On screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Unauthenticated or Direct Access Attempt
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Add Transaction screen without an active session (i.e., no communication area data is present), the system identifies this as an unauthenticated or direct access attempt and initiates a redirect to the Sign-On screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the user has no active session (EIBCALEN equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to redirect the unauthenticated user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The destination program is set to the Sign-On screen identified as 'COSGN00C', which will be used as the target for the redirect

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Sign-On Screen as Redirect Destination for Unauthenticated Access
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no active session is detected, the system sets the target destination program to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) so that the user can be properly authenticated before accessing the Add Transaction functionality.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined the user must be redirected to the Sign-On screen due to no active session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is preparing the navigation context before executing the redirect
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system records the current transaction identifier (WS-TRANID) into the 'from transaction' field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), records the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) into the 'from program' field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), and resets the program context indicator (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) to zero to indicate a fresh navigation state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Current Program and Transaction Context Before Redirect
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before redirecting the user to the Sign-On screen, the system captures and stores the current transaction identifier and program name as the originating context. This allows the Sign-On screen and subsequent navigation to know where the user came from, enabling a potential return to this screen after successful authentication.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The destination has been set to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) and the current program and transaction context have been recorded in the communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the redirect
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the Sign-On screen program (COSGN00C) along with the full communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) containing the originating program name and transaction identifier, so that the user is presented with the Sign-On screen and the system retains the return navigation path

all_rules.Rule_Name: Redirect Unauthenticated User to Sign-On Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After recording the navigation context, the system transfers control to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C), passing along the communication area that contains the recorded navigation details. This ensures the user must authenticate before being able to add a transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user navigates to the Add Transaction screen and the program context indicates this is NOT a re-entry (the re-enterable flag is not yet set in the communication area)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates the session state at the start of processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program identifies this as a first-time entry and immediately sets the re-enterable flag to TRUE in the communication area, so that all future visits to this screen within the same session are recognized as returning entries and bypass the initialization logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Mark First-Time Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Add Transaction screen for the first time in a session (the program has not been re-entered), the system must identify this as an initial entry and immediately mark the session so that subsequent visits are treated as returning entries, preventing repeated initialization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has confirmed this is a first-time entry to the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen initialization process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All output fields on the Add Transaction screen (COTRN2AO) are cleared to LOW-VALUES (blank/reset state), and the cursor is positioned at the Account ID field (ACTIDINL set to -1) so the user can begin entering transaction details from a clean form

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Add Transaction Screen on First Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: On the first visit to the Add Transaction screen, all screen output fields must be cleared to their lowest values and the cursor must be positioned at the Account ID input field, ensuring the user starts with a completely blank form.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen has been initialized and the communication area contains context from the prior screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the pre-selected transaction value (CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED) in the communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED contains a value that is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES, the system determines that a Card Number was passed from the prior screen and proceeds to pre-populate the Card Number field; otherwise, if CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED is SPACES or LOW-VALUES, the system determines no prior selection was made and displays a blank Add Transaction screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Whether a Card Number Was Passed from a Prior Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After initializing the screen, the system must check whether the user arrived at the Add Transaction screen with a pre-selected Card Number carried over from a prior screen. This determines whether the screen should be pre-populated or displayed blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that a Card Number value (CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED) was passed from the prior screen and is not blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The pre-population step executes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number input field (CARDNINI of COTRN2AI) on the Add Transaction screen is populated with the value from CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED, making it available for immediate processing and display to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pre-Populate Card Number from Prior Screen Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number has been passed from a prior screen, the system must automatically populate the Card Number input field on the Add Transaction screen with the value carried over, so the user does not need to re-enter it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number input field (CARDNINI of COTRN2AI) has been pre-populated with a value passed from the prior screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system invokes the PROCESS-ENTER-KEY routine
