Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system executes the full Enter key processing flow, which includes: (1) validating the Card Number is numeric, (2) looking up the Card Number in the card cross-reference file to retrieve the associated Account ID, (3) populating the Account ID field (ACTIDINI of COTRN2AI) with the retrieved value, and (4) proceeding through data field validation and confirmation checks — displaying the Add Transaction screen with both Card Number and Account ID populated, or showing an appropriate error message if the Card Number is invalid or not found

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Associated Account ID for Pre-Populated Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Card Number is pre-populated from the prior screen, the system must immediately process it through the full Enter key processing logic to validate the Card Number, look up the associated Account ID from the card cross-reference, and populate the Account ID field — ensuring the screen is fully resolved before being displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Add Transaction screen has been initialized, the cursor is set to the Account ID field, and no Card Number was passed from a prior screen (CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED is SPACES or LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system invokes the SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Add Transaction screen (map COTRN2A from mapset COTRN02) is displayed to the user with all input fields blank, the header populated with current date, time, transaction ID, and program name, no error messages shown, and the cursor positioned at the Account ID field — awaiting the user's input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Add Transaction Screen When No Prior Selection Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user navigates directly to the Add Transaction screen without a prior Card Number selection, the system must display a fully blank Add Transaction screen with the cursor on the Account ID field, prompting the user to enter either an Account ID or Card Number to begin.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Number pre-populated from the prior screen has been successfully validated and processed through PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, and the associated Account ID has been retrieved from the card cross-reference
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN routine is invoked as part of the PROCESS-ENTER-KEY flow
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Add Transaction screen (map COTRN2A from mapset COTRN02) is displayed with the Card Number field (CARDNINI) and Account ID field (ACTIDINI) both populated with their respective values, the header showing current date, time, transaction ID, and program name, and any relevant validation messages or confirmation prompts shown — allowing the user to proceed with entering the remaining transaction details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Add Transaction Screen with Pre-Populated Card Number and Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the pre-populated Card Number has been processed and the associated Account ID has been retrieved, the system displays the Add Transaction screen showing both the Card Number and Account ID fields populated, ready for the user to complete the remaining transaction details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user accesses the Add Transaction screen and a valid communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) exists from a prior interaction (EIBCALEN is not zero), and the program re-entry flag (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) is already set to TRUE indicating the user has visited this screen before
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates the re-entry flag from the loaded communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program identifies this as a returning user visit and proceeds to receive and process the user's screen input, bypassing the first-time initialization logic (screen clearing, cursor positioning, and pre-population)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Returning User Session for Add Transaction Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the user is returning to the Add Transaction screen (i.e., has already visited it at least once in the current session) by checking the program re-entry flag in the communication area, and routes them to the screen input reception flow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A returning user has submitted the Add Transaction screen (COTRN2A / COTRN02) by pressing a function key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system receives the screen input
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All field values entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen are captured into the input map (COTRN2AI), including Account ID, Card Number, Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Description, Amount, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip, and Confirmation indicator, making them available for key evaluation and business processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Receive User Input from Add Transaction Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Captures all field values entered by the user on the Add Transaction screen (COTRN2A in mapset COTRN02), including Account ID, Card Number, transaction details, merchant information, dates, amount, and the confirmation indicator, making them available for subsequent processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Add Transaction screen and all field inputs have been received into COTRN2AI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the function key identifier (EIBAID) pressed by the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes processing as follows: if ENTER key (DFHENTER) was pressed, route to Enter Key Processing; if PF3 (DFHPF3) was pressed, route to Navigate Back; if PF4 (DFHPF4) was pressed, route to Clear Screen; if PF5 (DFHPF5) was pressed, route to Copy Last Transaction; if any other key was pressed, route to Invalid Key Handling

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Function Key to Determine Processing Route
all_rules.Rule_Description: After receiving screen input, the system evaluates which function key the user pressed (EIBAID) to determine the appropriate processing path: Enter for transaction submission, PF3 for back navigation, PF4 for screen clear, PF5 for copying the last transaction, or any other key triggers an invalid key error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has filled in transaction details on the Add Transaction screen and the screen input has been received
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the Enter key (DFHENTER)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Enter Key Processing routine (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY), which will validate all input fields and, if valid and confirmed, add the transaction to the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Enter Key Processing for Transaction Submission
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses the Enter key on the Add Transaction screen, the system routes control to the Enter Key Processing routine, which performs input validation and, upon confirmation, adds the transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and the screen input has been received
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF3 (DFHPF3)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system checks the originating program stored in the communication area (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM): if CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM contains a valid program name (not spaces or low-values), that program name is set as the navigation target (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM); if CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces or low-values, the navigation target defaults to the main menu program 'COMEN01C'; the system then transfers control to the determined target program, passing the current session communication area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Navigate Back to Previous Screen via PF3
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 on the Add Transaction screen, the system navigates back to the originating program. If no originating program is recorded in the session, the system defaults to the main menu (COMEN01C).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and the screen input has been received
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF4 (DFHPF4)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Clear Current Screen routine (CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN), which resets all input fields to spaces (Account ID, Card Number, Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount, Description, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, Merchant Zip, and Confirmation), positions the cursor on the Account ID field, clears any existing messages, and redisplays the blank Add Transaction screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Clear Screen via PF4
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF4 on the Add Transaction screen, the system clears all input fields on the screen, allowing the user to start a fresh transaction entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen, has entered a valid Account ID or Card Number, and the screen input has been received
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF5 (DFHPF5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Copy Last Transaction Data routine (COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA), which first validates the Account ID or Card Number key fields, then retrieves the last transaction record from the transaction file, and if no key field errors exist, copies the following fields from the last transaction into the screen: Transaction Type Code, Category Code, Source, Amount (formatted), Description, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant Zip; the system then proceeds to Enter Key Processing to validate the pre-populated data and prompt for confirmation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Copy Last Transaction Data via PF5
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF5 on the Add Transaction screen, the system retrieves the most recently added transaction's details and pre-populates the screen fields, allowing the user to reuse transaction data as a template for a new entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and the screen input has been received
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any key other than Enter (DFHENTER), PF3 (DFHPF3), PF4 (DFHPF4), or PF5 (DFHPF5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (WS-ERR-FLG), populates the error message with the standard invalid key message (CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) into WS-MESSAGE, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message shown, without performing any transaction processing or field validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Invalid Function Key Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses any function key other than Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5 on the Add Transaction screen, the system sets an error condition and displays an invalid key message, redisplaying the screen without processing any input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and has pressed the Enter key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Enter key processing routine is triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Account ID and Card Number validation routine (VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS) as the first step before any other validation or processing occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Account or Card Number Validation on Enter Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses the Enter key on the Add Transaction screen, the system must first validate the Account ID or Card Number before proceeding with any other processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID or Card Number validation step has been completed during Enter key processing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Control returns from the key field validation routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the transaction data fields validation routine (VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS) as the second step, validating Type Code, Category Code, Source, Description, Amount, Original Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant Zip before evaluating the Confirmation field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Transaction Data Fields Validation After Key Field Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After Account ID or Card Number validation completes, the system must validate all transaction data fields before checking the confirmation field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has completed all required transaction fields on the Add Transaction screen and both key field and data field validations have passed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains the value 'Y' or 'y' (case-insensitive yes)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to execute the Add Transaction routine (ADD-TRANSACTION) to save the new transaction record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Add Transaction When User Confirms
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'Y' or 'y' in the Confirmation field after all validations pass, the system proceeds to add the transaction to the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has completed the Add Transaction screen and both key field and data field validations have passed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains 'N', 'n', a space character, or is empty (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the message 'Confirm to add this transaction...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Confirmation field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen awaiting the user's explicit confirmation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prompt User for Confirmation When Confirmation Field is Blank or Declined
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters 'N', 'n', or leaves the Confirmation field blank or empty, the system must prompt the user to confirm before the transaction can be added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has completed the Add Transaction screen and both key field and data field validations have passed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) contains any value other than 'Y', 'y', 'N', 'n', a space, or empty (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Confirmation field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen requiring the user to enter a valid confirmation value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Invalid Confirmation Field Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters any value other than Y, y, N, n, or blank in the Confirmation field, the system must reject the input and inform the user of the valid values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses the Enter key on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Enter key processing routine (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system enforces the following strict sequence: (1) Account ID or Card Number validation is performed first, (2) all transaction data field validations are performed second, and (3) the Confirmation field value is evaluated last — the system does not evaluate the Confirmation field unless both prior validation steps have completed without errors

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enforce Sequential Validation Before Confirmation Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Enter key processing enforces a strict sequential order: key field validation must complete first, followed by data field validation, and only then is the Confirmation field evaluated. This ensures all data is valid before the user is asked to confirm the transaction addition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All key field and data field validations have passed and the Confirmation field contains 'Y' or 'y'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The confirmation check evaluates to a positive confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the ADD-TRANSACTION routine to generate a new Transaction ID, populate the transaction record with all entered data, and write the transaction to the transaction file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route Confirmed Transaction to Add Transaction Logic
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the user provides explicit confirmation with 'Y' or 'y', the system routes processing to the Add Transaction logic to persist the new transaction record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and the communication area contains the calling program identifier (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF3 to navigate back
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM contains a valid program name (not spaces or low-values), the destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) is set to that calling program name; otherwise, the destination is set to the default main menu program 'COMEN01C'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Navigation Destination on PF3 Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 to navigate back, the system determines the correct destination program. If the screen was invoked from a known calling program, that program is set as the destination. If no calling program is recorded, the default main menu (COMEN01C) is used as the destination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The navigation destination program (CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) has been evaluated after PF3 was pressed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The destination program identifier is still empty (spaces or low-values) after the initial determination step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The destination program is overridden and set to the Sign-On screen program 'COSGN00C', ensuring the user is always redirected to a valid screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Fallback to Sign-On Screen When Destination Is Still Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: As a safety measure, after the destination program has been determined, if the destination program identifier is still empty or unset (low-values or spaces), the system overrides it and redirects the user to the Sign-On screen (COSGN00C) to ensure navigation never fails.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The destination program has been determined and the system is about to transfer control away from the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The navigation back action is being executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (WS-TRANID) is recorded as the originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) in the communication area, the current program name (WS-PGMNAME) is recorded as the originating program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) in the communication area, and the program context indicator (CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT) is reset to zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Current Program Context in Communication Area Before Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before transferring control to the destination program, the system records the current program's identity and the current transaction ID into the communication area, and resets the program context indicator to zero. This allows the destination program to know which program initiated the navigation and to maintain session continuity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The destination program has been validated and set in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, and the communication area has been updated with the current program context
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the navigation transfer
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Control is transferred to the destination program identified in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, and the full communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is passed to the destination program to maintain session continuity

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transfer Control to Destination Program with Communication Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system transfers control to the determined destination program, passing the full communication area so that session state, user context, and navigation history are preserved across the program transition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen with any data entered or displayed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses the PF4 function key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system triggers the Clear Screen process, which initializes all input fields to empty and redisplays the blank Add Transaction screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Clear Screen Action on PF4 Key Press
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses the PF4 function key on the Add Transaction screen, the system initiates the clear screen process to reset all input fields and redisplay a blank form.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID field (ACTIDINI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered or displayed account identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Account ID Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Account ID input field must be cleared to spaces so the user can enter a new account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number field (CARDNINI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered or auto-populated card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Card Number Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Card Number input field must be cleared to spaces so the user can enter a new card number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field (TTYPCDI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered transaction type

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Transaction Type Code Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Type Code input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Code field (TCATCDI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered category code

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Transaction Category Code Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Category Code input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Source field (TRNSRCI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered transaction source

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Transaction Source Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Source input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount field (TRNAMTI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered amount value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Transaction Amount Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Amount input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Description field (TDESCI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered description

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Transaction Description Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Description input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Origination Date field (TORIGDTI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered origination date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Origination Date Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Origination Date input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Processing Date field (TPROCDTI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered processing date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Processing Date Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Transaction Processing Date input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Merchant ID field (MIDI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered merchant identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Merchant ID Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Merchant ID input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Merchant Name field (MNAMEI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered merchant name

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Merchant Name Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Merchant Name input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Merchant City field (MCITYI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered merchant city

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Merchant City Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Merchant City input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Merchant Zip Code field (MZIPI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered merchant zip code

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Merchant Zip Code Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Merchant Zip Code input field must be cleared to spaces.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) is set to spaces, removing any previously entered confirmation value (Y or N)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Confirmation Field on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, the Confirmation input field must be cleared to spaces, removing any prior Y/N confirmation entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF4 to clear the Add Transaction screen and there may be an existing error or informational message displayed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the field initialization process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message area (WS-MESSAGE) is set to spaces, ensuring no prior error or status message is carried over to the refreshed blank screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Existing Error and Status Messages on Screen Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the clear screen action is triggered, any existing error or status messages currently displayed on the screen must be cleared so the blank form is presented without any prior message context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has cleared all input fields on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank Add Transaction screen is prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is set to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL set to -1) so that the user's focus is directed to the first required input field upon screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Cursor Focus to Account ID Field After Screen Clear
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all fields are cleared, the cursor must be automatically positioned on the Account ID field so the user can immediately begin entering a new transaction without manually navigating to the first field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All input fields have been cleared, the message area is empty, and the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Add Transaction screen (map COTRN2A from mapset COTRN02) to the user's terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Add Transaction screen is displayed with all input fields blank, no error or status messages shown, the header populated with the current date and time, and the cursor positioned on the Account ID field ready for new input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Blank Add Transaction Screen After Field Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all input fields and messages have been cleared and the cursor positioned, the system must redisplay the Add Transaction screen in its blank state, including refreshed header information such as current date and time.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and presses PF5 to copy the last transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Neither the Account ID field nor the Card Number field contains a value (both are spaces or empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON, displays the message 'Account or Card Number must be entered...', positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and redisplays the screen without proceeding to retrieve any transaction data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Require Account ID or Card Number Before Copying Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 to copy the last transaction, the system must first verify that either an Account ID or a Card Number has been entered. If neither is provided, the copy operation is blocked and an error is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen, presses PF5, and has entered a value in the Account ID field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON, displays the message 'Account ID must be Numeric...', positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and redisplays the screen without proceeding to the cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account ID is Numeric When Provided for Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and has entered an Account ID, the system must verify that the Account ID contains only numeric characters before attempting any cross-reference lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen, presses PF5, the Account ID field is blank, and a value has been entered in the Card Number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number field contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON, displays the message 'Card Number must be Numeric...', positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and redisplays the screen without proceeding to the cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Card Number is Numeric When Provided for Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and has entered a Card Number (with no Account ID), the system must verify that the Card Number contains only numeric characters before attempting any cross-reference lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and presses PF5
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field contains a value (not spaces or empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system uses the Account ID path for cross-reference lookup and does not evaluate the Card Number field as the primary key, even if a Card Number is also present on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Takes Priority Over Card Number for Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5, the system evaluates the Account ID field first. If the Account ID is populated, it is used for the cross-reference lookup regardless of whether a Card Number is also present. The Card Number path is only taken when the Account ID is blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF5, has entered a valid numeric Account ID, and the Account ID cross-reference lookup is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is found in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the associated Card Number from the cross-reference record and populates the Card Number field on the screen with that value, then proceeds to retrieve the last transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Card Number from Account ID Cross-Reference for Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and provides a valid numeric Account ID, the system looks up the Account ID in the Account-to-Card cross-reference file to retrieve the associated Card Number, which is then populated on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF5, has entered a numeric Account ID, and the system attempts to look up the Account ID in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON, displays the message 'Account ID NOT found...', positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and redisplays the screen without retrieving any transaction data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error When Account ID Not Found in Cross-Reference During Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and the entered Account ID does not exist in the Account-to-Card cross-reference file, the copy operation is blocked and an appropriate error message is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF5, the Account ID field is blank, the user has entered a valid numeric Card Number, and the Card Number cross-reference lookup is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number is found in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the associated Account ID from the cross-reference record and populates the Account ID field on the screen with that value, then proceeds to retrieve the last transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Account ID from Card Number Cross-Reference for Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and provides a valid numeric Card Number (with no Account ID entered), the system looks up the Card Number in the Card-to-Account cross-reference file to retrieve the associated Account ID, which is then populated on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF5, has entered a numeric Card Number, and the system attempts to look up the Card Number in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Number is not found in the cross-reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to ON, displays the message 'Card Number NOT found...', positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and redisplays the screen without retrieving any transaction data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error When Card Number Not Found in Cross-Reference During Copy Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses PF5 and the entered Card Number does not exist in the Card-to-Account cross-reference file, the copy operation is blocked and an appropriate error message is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID or Card Number has been successfully validated and cross-referenced
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a search for the most recently added transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Transaction ID search key to the highest possible value, starts a backward browse of the transaction file from that position, reads the previous (most recent) transaction record, and then ends the browse operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Most Recently Added Transaction by Browsing from Highest Transaction ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a valid Account ID or Card Number is confirmed, the system identifies the most recently added transaction by positioning to the end of the transaction file (using the highest possible Transaction ID) and reading backwards to retrieve the last record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID or Card Number has been validated and the system is browsing the transaction file backwards from the highest Transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction file contains no records (end of file is reached immediately)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Transaction ID to zero, the error flag remains OFF, and the screen fields are not populated with any transaction data; the system proceeds to the input validation step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle No Transactions Found When Copying Last Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the system attempts to retrieve the most recently added transaction and the transaction file contains no records, the system handles this gracefully by setting the Transaction ID to zero, which prevents the copy operation from populating the screen with invalid data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID or Card Number has been validated, the cross-reference lookup succeeded, the most recent transaction was retrieved, and the error flag is OFF
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system pre-populates the screen with the last transaction's data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the following fields from the retrieved transaction record to the corresponding screen input fields: Transaction Type Code, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Source, Transaction Amount (formatted for display), Transaction Description, Origination Date, Processing Date, Merchant ID, Merchant Name, Merchant City, and Merchant Zip. The Account ID, Card Number, and Confirm fields are not overwritten.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pre-populate Screen Fields with Last Transaction Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the most recently added transaction is successfully retrieved and no errors have occurred during key field validation, the system copies all transaction detail fields from the retrieved record onto the screen for the user to review and modify. Note: Account ID, Card Number, and Confirm fields are not copied from the last transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user pressed PF5 and an error was encountered during Account ID or Card Number validation (error flag is ON)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to pre-populate the screen with the last transaction's data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips the pre-population of all transaction detail fields and does not copy any data from the retrieved transaction record to the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Screen Pre-population When Key Field Validation Errors Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: If any error occurred during Account ID or Card Number validation (error flag is ON), the system does not copy the last transaction's data to the screen fields, ensuring that invalid or incomplete key information does not result in misleading pre-populated data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The last transaction data has been retrieved and the screen fields have been pre-populated (or the error flag is ON from key validation)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The copy last transaction process completes its data retrieval and population step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Process Enter Key routine, which performs full validation of all input key fields and data fields, and then prompts the user to confirm the transaction by entering Y or N in the Confirm field before any transaction is saved

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Input Validation and Confirmation After Pre-populating Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the screen has been pre-populated with the last transaction's data, the system immediately invokes the full input validation and confirmation workflow, allowing the user to review the copied data, make modifications, and confirm before the transaction is added.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and has previously entered the screen (program re-entry state is active), and the recognized function keys are: Enter (to submit), PF3 (to go back), PF4 (to clear screen), and PF5 (to copy last transaction data)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses any function key other than Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system classifies the key press as unrecognized and initiates the invalid key error handling process, preventing any transaction processing or navigation action from occurring

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Unrecognized Function Key on Add Transaction Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user presses any function key that is not one of the recognized keys (Enter, PF3, PF4, or PF5) on the Add Transaction screen, the system must identify it as an invalid key and trigger the error handling flow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen in an active session and has pressed an unrecognized function key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that the pressed key does not match any of the valid function keys (Enter, PF3, PF4, PF5)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y' (active/on), marking the current interaction as an error state that must be communicated to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Error Flag When Invalid Key Is Pressed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unrecognized function key is detected on the Add Transaction screen, the system must activate the error flag to indicate that an error condition exists, which will affect subsequent screen rendering and processing behavior.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The error flag has been set to active due to an unrecognized function key press on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to redisplay the Add Transaction screen after detecting an invalid key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system loads the standard invalid key message (defined in the application message catalog as CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY) into the screen message field, replacing any previous message content

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Standard Invalid Key Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an unrecognized function key is pressed, the system must load the standard invalid key error message from the application message catalog into the working message area, so it can be displayed to the user on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The error flag is set to active and the invalid key error message has been loaded into the message field, and the user is on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the Add Transaction screen back to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system populates the screen header with the current date (MM/DD/YY format) and current time (HH:MM:SS format), the transaction name, and program name; moves the invalid key error message to the screen error message display field; and redisplays the full Add Transaction screen (COTRN2A in mapset COTRN02) with all previously entered data preserved and the error message visible, then waits for the next user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Redisplay Add Transaction Screen with Invalid Key Error Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: After detecting an invalid key press and loading the error message, the system must redisplay the Add Transaction screen to the user with the error message visible, the current date and time in the header, and the screen awaiting the next valid user action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and has submitted the form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID field is empty (contains only spaces or is blank)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID validation is skipped entirely and the system proceeds to check whether a Card Number was entered instead

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Presence Check Before Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the user has entered an Account ID on the Add Transaction screen. If the Account ID field is blank, the Account ID validation path is skipped entirely.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the Account ID field on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered Account ID contains non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, or mixed content)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error indicator, displays the error message 'Account ID must be Numeric...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID field, and returns the user to the Add Transaction screen without proceeding further

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Numeric Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Account ID entered by the user contains only numeric characters. Non-numeric Account IDs are rejected with an error message before any lookup is attempted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a non-numeric value in the Account ID field on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that the Account ID is not numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system marks the transaction entry session as having an error, displays the message 'Account ID must be Numeric...' in the screen message area, sets the cursor focus to the Account ID input field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen so the user can correct the value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Non-Numeric Error Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account ID fails the numeric validation check, the system activates the error state, populates the error message area with a descriptive message, and redirects the user back to the Add Transaction screen with the cursor focused on the Account ID field for correction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a valid numeric Account ID on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID passes the numeric character validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system converts the Account ID string to its numeric equivalent using a numeric value function and stores the converted numeric value back into the Account ID field in a standardized format, ready for cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Conversion to Numeric Format
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the Account ID passes the numeric character check, it is converted from its display string format into a pure numeric value and stored back into the Account ID field in a standardized numeric format for consistent processing and lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID has been entered, validated as numeric, and converted to its standardized numeric format
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is ready to proceed with the Account ID cross-reference lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the Account ID as the lookup key, invokes the Account-to-Card cross-reference lookup process, and upon a successful lookup, automatically populates the Card Number field on the Add Transaction screen with the Card Number associated with the given Account ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cross-Reference Lookup Invocation
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Account ID is successfully validated and converted to numeric format, the system initiates a lookup in the Account-to-Card cross-reference to retrieve the Card Number associated with the given Account ID. The retrieved Card Number is then automatically populated in the Card Number field on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered an Account ID on the Add Transaction screen and the Account ID field contains a non-empty, numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to look up the Account ID in the cross-reference index file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system converts the entered Account ID to its numeric equivalent using the NUMVAL function, stores the result as the internal numeric Account ID (WS-ACCT-ID-N), and uses this numeric value as the search key (XREF-ACCT-ID) for the cross-reference file lookup, also updating the Account ID display field with the normalized numeric value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Convert Account ID to Numeric Format Before Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before searching the cross-reference file, the entered Account ID must be converted from its display format into a pure numeric value to be used as the search key.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account ID has been converted to numeric format and is ready to be used as a search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup on the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file (CXACAIX) using the numeric Account ID as the record identifier key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full cross-reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD) associated with the given Account ID from the CXACAIX file, making the associated Card Number available for further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Look Up Account ID in Cross-Reference Index File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must search the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file (CXACAIX) using the provided Account ID as the search key to retrieve the associated Card Number record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup of the entered Account ID in the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file (CXACAIX)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID is not found in the cross-reference file (record does not exist)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Account ID NOT found...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID input field to highlight it for correction, and returns the Add Transaction screen to the user for correction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Not Found in Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the entered Account ID does not exist in the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file, the system must inform the user and prompt them to correct the value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup of the entered Account ID in the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file (CXACAIX)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The lookup encounters an unexpected failure condition (neither a successful retrieval nor a standard 'not found' response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Account ID input field to highlight it for correction, and returns the Add Transaction screen to the user for correction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Cross-Reference Lookup System Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the cross-reference file lookup for the Account ID fails due to an unexpected system condition (not a simple 'not found'), the system must notify the user that the account could not be verified.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has successfully looked up the entered Account ID in the Card-Account Cross-Reference Index file (CXACAIX) and the Account ID exists in the file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cross-reference record is successfully retrieved with a normal response
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the Card Number (XREF-CARD-NUM) from the retrieved cross-reference record and automatically populates the Card Number input field (CARDNINI) on the Add Transaction screen with this value, then proceeds to the transaction data field validations

all_rules.Rule_Name: Auto-Populate Card Number from Account Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid Account ID is found in the cross-reference file, the system automatically retrieves and populates the associated Card Number on the screen, eliminating the need for the user to manually enter the Card Number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Add Transaction screen and has submitted the form
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Card Number field and finds it contains only spaces or empty values (blank)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Number validation path is skipped entirely and the system proceeds to the Account/Card Number presence check to determine if neither field was entered

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Entry Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the user has provided a Card Number on the Add Transaction screen. This routing condition decides whether Card Number validation should proceed or whether the system should fall through to the Account/Card presence check.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the Card Number field on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether the entered Card Number contains only numeric digits and finds it contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Card Number must be Numeric...' on the Add Transaction screen, positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and halts further processing awaiting user correction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Must Be Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that a Card Number entered by the user contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters (letters, special characters, etc.) are not permitted in the Card Number field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a Card Number that has passed the numeric validation check
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the validated Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system converts the Card Number from its text representation to a numeric value, stores the numeric value in the Card Number cross-reference lookup field, and updates the Card Number input field with the normalized numeric value before proceeding to the Card Number cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Numeric Format Conversion
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number passes the numeric check, it is converted from its display/string format into a pure numeric value and stored back into both the working storage numeric field and the Card Number input field to ensure consistent formatting before the cross-reference lookup is performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a Card Number that has passed both the presence check and the numeric validation, and the Card Number has been converted to numeric format
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is ready to resolve the Card Number to its associated Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the Card Number cross-reference lookup (READ-CCXREF-FILE) using the numeric Card Number as the lookup key, and upon a successful lookup, automatically populates the Account ID field on the screen with the Account ID retrieved from the cross-reference record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Card Number Cross-Reference Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a Card Number has been validated and converted to numeric format, the system invokes the Card Number cross-reference lookup process to retrieve the associated Account ID. This links the entered Card Number to its corresponding account in the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a value in the Card Number field on the Add Transaction screen, and the Account ID field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Card Number field and finds that the entered value contains non-numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Card Number must be Numeric...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and returns the screen to the user for correction without performing any cross-reference lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Must Be Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters a Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, the system must verify that the Card Number contains only numeric characters before attempting any cross-reference lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Card Number in the Card Number field on the Add Transaction screen, and the Account ID field is blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms the Card Number is numeric and proceeds to prepare it for cross-reference lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system computes the numeric value of the Card Number using the NUMVAL function, stores the result in the cross-reference search key field (XREF-CARD-NUM), and also updates the Card Number display field (CARDNINI) with the normalized numeric value before performing the lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Converted to Numeric Format Before Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before the Card Number can be used to look up the associated Account ID in the cross-reference file, the system must convert the entered Card Number from its display format into a pure numeric value and store it in the cross-reference search key field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid numeric Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, the Card Number has been converted to numeric format, and the cross-reference search key (XREF-CARD-NUM) has been populated with the numeric Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a direct read of the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) using the Card Number as the record identifier key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full cross-reference record containing the associated Account ID, and the lookup result (found, not found, or system failure) determines the next processing step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Cross-Reference Lookup to Retrieve Account ID
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Card Number is validated and converted, the system must look up the Card Number in the Card-to-Account Cross-Reference file (CCXREF) to retrieve the associated Account ID. This lookup uses the Card Number as the search key.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a valid Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, and the system has successfully located the Card Number in the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cross-reference lookup returns a successful result with the associated Account ID in the cross-reference record (XREF-ACCT-ID)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the retrieved Account ID from the cross-reference record into the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI) on the Add Transaction screen, and processing continues to the Data Field Validation step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Auto-Populated from Card Number Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Card Number is successfully found in the cross-reference file, the system automatically retrieves and populates the Account ID field on the screen with the Account ID associated with that Card Number, eliminating the need for the user to manually enter the Account ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, the Card Number has been validated as numeric and converted, and the system has performed a lookup in the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cross-reference file lookup returns a 'Not Found' result, indicating the entered Card Number does not exist in the system
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Card Number NOT found...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and returns the Add Transaction screen to the user for correction; no further validation or processing is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Not Found in Cross-Reference
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the entered Card Number does not exist in the Card Cross-Reference file, the system must inform the user that the Card Number is invalid and prompt them to correct it before the transaction can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, the Card Number has been validated as numeric and converted, and the system has attempted a lookup in the Card Cross-Reference file (CCXREF)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cross-reference file lookup returns an unexpected failure result that is neither a successful retrieval nor a 'not found' condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Unable to lookup Card # in XREF file...' on the screen, positions the cursor on the Card Number field, and returns the Add Transaction screen to the user for correction; no further validation or processing is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Lookup System Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Card Number cross-reference lookup fails due to an unexpected system condition (other than a simple 'not found'), the system must notify the user that the lookup could not be completed and prompt them to retry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has entered a value in the Account ID field that is not blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether an Account ID or Card Number has been provided
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds directly to the Account ID lookup process to validate and cross-reference the Account ID, without checking the Card Number field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Account ID Lookup When Account ID Is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user provides an Account ID on the Add Transaction screen, the system recognizes its presence and routes processing to the Account ID lookup flow, bypassing the Card Number check entirely.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Account ID field is blank or empty, and the Card Number field contains a non-blank, non-empty value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether an Account ID or Card Number has been provided
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system proceeds to the Card Number lookup process to validate and cross-reference the Card Number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route to Card Number Lookup When Only Card Number Is Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user leaves the Account ID blank but provides a Card Number on the Add Transaction screen, the system recognizes the Card Number presence and routes processing to the Card Number lookup flow.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and both the Account ID field and the Card Number field are blank or empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether an Account ID or Card Number has been provided
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Account or Card Number must be entered...', positions the cursor on the Account ID field to highlight it for correction, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen prompting the user to enter either an Account ID or a Card Number before proceeding

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Transaction Entry When Both Account ID and Card Number Are Missing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user attempts to proceed on the Add Transaction screen without entering either an Account ID or a Card Number, the system must reject the action, display an error message, and highlight the Account ID field to guide the user to provide the required identifier.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has entered Account ID or Card Number successfully, and the system is validating transaction data fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Type Code field is empty (contains spaces or no value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to active, displays the error message 'Type CD can NOT be empty...', positions the cursor on the Transaction Type Code field, and returns the user to the Add Transaction screen with the error message displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type Code Mandatory Field Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that the Transaction Type Code field is not left empty or blank before a new transaction can be added. This is a mandatory field and must contain a value to proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Transaction Type Code field has been confirmed as non-empty, and the system is performing format validation on the field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Type Code field contains a non-numeric value (e.g., letters, special characters, or alphanumeric mix)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to active, displays the error message 'Type CD must be Numeric...', positions the cursor on the Transaction Type Code field, and returns the user to the Add Transaction screen with the error message displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type Code Numeric Format Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that the Transaction Type Code field contains only numeric characters. Even when a value is present, it must be strictly numeric to be accepted as a valid transaction type.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has entered valid Account ID or Card Number, and the system is validating transaction data fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Category Code field is left empty (contains only spaces or no value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to 'Y', (2) display the error message 'Category CD can NOT be empty...' on the screen, (3) position the cursor on the Transaction Category Code field to prompt correction, and (4) redisplay the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further processing until the field is populated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Category Code Must Not Be Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Transaction Category Code field is not left blank or empty before a transaction can be added. This is a mandatory field and must contain a value to proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Transaction Category Code field has been populated with a non-empty value, and the system is performing format validation on transaction data fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Category Code field contains one or more non-numeric characters (e.g., letters, special characters, or alphanumeric combinations)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to 'Y', (2) display the error message 'Category CD must be Numeric...' on the screen, (3) position the cursor on the Transaction Category Code field to prompt correction, and (4) redisplay the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further processing until a valid numeric value is entered

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Category Code Must Be Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Transaction Category Code contains only numeric characters. After confirming the field is not empty, the system further verifies that the entered value is a valid numeric code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has successfully provided a valid Account ID or Card Number, a valid Transaction Type Code, and a valid Transaction Category Code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the Transaction Source field is empty or contains only blank spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to indicate a validation failure, (2) display the error message 'Source can NOT be empty...' on the Add Transaction screen, (3) position the cursor on the Transaction Source input field to direct the user's attention, and (4) redisplay the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further field validations or transaction processing from occurring until the error is corrected

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Source Field Mandatory Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Transaction Source field is not left empty or blank when a user submits the Add Transaction screen. This is a mandatory field check that occurs after Type Code and Category Code have been successfully validated. If the field is missing, an error is flagged, an error message is displayed, and the cursor is positioned on the Transaction Source field to guide the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has successfully passed Account ID or Card Number validation, and all prior mandatory fields (Transaction Type Code, Category Code, and Source) have been provided
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the Add Transaction form and the Transaction Description field is empty or contains only blank spaces
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the error flag to 'Y' to indicate a validation failure, (2) display the error message 'Description can NOT be empty...' on the screen, (3) position the cursor on the Transaction Description field to guide the user to the missing field, and (4) redisplay the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction submission from occurring

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Description Mandatory Field Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that the Transaction Description field is not left empty when a user attempts to add a new transaction. If the Description is missing, an error is raised, the field is highlighted, and the user is prompted to provide the required information before proceeding.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has provided Account ID or Card Number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the form with the Transaction Amount field left blank (empty or containing only spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator, display the error message 'Amount can NOT be empty...' on the Add Transaction screen, and position the cursor on the Transaction Amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Mandatory Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the Transaction Amount field is not left blank before any format checks are performed. If the amount is empty, the transaction cannot proceed and an error is displayed to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and the Transaction Amount field is not empty
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first character (position 1) of the Transaction Amount is neither a plus sign '+' nor a minus sign '-'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator, display the error message 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99' on the Add Transaction screen, and position the cursor on the Transaction Amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Sign Character Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the first character of the Transaction Amount is either a plus sign (+) indicating a credit or a minus sign (-) indicating a debit. The sign is mandatory and must appear as the very first character of the amount field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Transaction Amount is not empty, and the first character is a valid sign ('+' or '-')
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Any of the characters in positions 2 through 9 of the Transaction Amount are not numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator, display the error message 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99' on the Add Transaction screen, and position the cursor on the Transaction Amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Integer Digits Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the eight characters following the sign character in the Transaction Amount (positions 2 through 9) are all numeric digits, representing the whole number portion of the transaction amount up to 99,999,999.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Transaction Amount is not empty, the first character is a valid sign, and positions 2 through 9 are numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The character at position 10 of the Transaction Amount is not a decimal point '.'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator, display the error message 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99' on the Add Transaction screen, and position the cursor on the Transaction Amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Decimal Point Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the tenth character of the Transaction Amount is a decimal point (period '.'), which separates the whole number portion from the cents portion of the transaction amount.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen, the Transaction Amount is not empty, the first character is a valid sign, positions 2 through 9 are numeric, and position 10 is a decimal point
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either of the characters at positions 11 or 12 of the Transaction Amount are not numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reject the submission, set the error indicator, display the error message 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99' on the Add Transaction screen, and position the cursor on the Transaction Amount field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Cents Digits Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the two characters following the decimal point in the Transaction Amount (positions 11 and 12) are numeric digits, representing the cents portion of the transaction amount.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has entered a Transaction Amount
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Amount is not empty AND position 1 is '+' or '-' AND positions 2 through 9 are all numeric AND position 10 is '.' AND positions 11 through 12 are numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must accept the Transaction Amount as valid, set no error for this field, and continue processing the remaining transaction data field validations without displaying any error message for the amount

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Validation Passed
all_rules.Rule_Description: Confirms that the Transaction Amount has successfully passed all format validations: it is not empty, begins with a valid sign character, contains 8 numeric digits, has a decimal point at position 10, and ends with 2 numeric cent digits. Processing continues to the next validation step.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user is on the Add Transaction screen and has filled in or left blank the Origination Date field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user submits the transaction form and the system evaluates the Origination Date field, and the Origination Date field contains only spaces or is empty (LOW-VALUES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Orig Date can NOT be empty...', positions the cursor on the Origination Date field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Mandatory Field Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that the Origination Date field is not left blank before any format validation is performed. If the field is empty, the transaction add process is halted and the user is prompted to provide a value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a non-empty value in the Origination Date field on the Add Transaction screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Origination Date format and the first 4 characters (positions 1 through 4) of the Origination Date are not all numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD', positions the cursor on the Origination Date field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Year (YYYY) Component Must Be Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the first four characters of the Origination Date, representing the year (YYYY), are numeric digits as required by the YYYY-MM-DD date format standard.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a non-empty value in the Origination Date field and the year portion (first 4 characters) has passed numeric validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Origination Date format and the 5th character (position 5) of the Origination Date is not a hyphen character '-'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD', positions the cursor on the Origination Date field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date First Separator Must Be a Hyphen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the 5th character of the Origination Date is a hyphen ('-'), acting as the separator between the year (YYYY) and month (MM) components of the YYYY-MM-DD format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a non-empty value in the Origination Date field and both the year (positions 1-4) and first hyphen separator (position 5) have passed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Origination Date format and characters at positions 6 and 7 (the month portion MM) of the Origination Date are not all numeric digits
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD', positions the cursor on the Origination Date field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Month (MM) Component Must Be Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that characters 6 and 7 of the Origination Date, representing the month (MM), are numeric digits as required by the YYYY-MM-DD date format standard.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a non-empty value in the Origination Date field and the year (positions 1-4), first hyphen (position 5), and month (positions 6-7) have all passed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the Origination Date format and the 8th character (position 8) of the Origination Date is not a hyphen character '-'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the error flag to 'Y', displays the error message 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD', positions the cursor on the Origination Date field, and redisplays the Add Transaction screen with the error message — preventing any further validation or transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Origination Date Second Separator Must Be a Hyphen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates that the 8th character of the Origination Date is a hyphen ('-'), acting as the separator between the month (MM) and day (DD) components of the YYYY-MM-DD format.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered a non-empty value in the Origination Date field and the year (positions 1-4), first hyphen (position 5), month (positions 6-7), and second hyphen (position 8) have all passed validation
